root.name: ライマン・ホスピタリティ・プロパティーズ

relations.text: ゲイロード・ホテルズとJWマリオットの全施設を運営受託
relations.text_en: Manages all Gaylord Hotels and JW Marriott properties

source.label: Ryman Hospitality 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Marriott is responsible for the day-to-day management of our Gaylord Hotels properties, our JW Marriott properties, the Inn at Opryland, and the AC Hotel.

relations.text_en: Minority investor in the OEG entertainment business

source.label: Ryman Hospitality 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Further, in 2022, we completed a strategic transaction to sell a minority interest in OEG to an affiliate of Atairos Group, Inc. ("Atairos") and its strategic partner NBCUniversal Media, LLC, who we believe will continue to help us expand the distribution of our OEG brands.

relations.text: OEGのブランド展開を支える戦略パートナー
relations.text_en: Strategic partner helping distribute OEG brands

source.label: Ryman Hospitality 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Further, in 2022, we completed a strategic transaction to sell a minority interest in OEG to an affiliate of Atairos Group, Inc. ("Atairos") and its strategic partner NBCUniversal Media, LLC, who we believe will continue to help us expand the distribution of our OEG brands.

relations.text: 「グランド・オール・オプリ」を毎週生放送
relations.text_en: Broadcasts the Grand Ole Opry live each week

source.label: Ryman Hospitality 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Each week, the Grand Ole Opry is broadcast live to millions of country lifestyle consumers on radio via WSM-AM and Sirius/XM Radio and streamed on the Internet.

relations.text: CCNB円形劇場の運営事業者に選定(11年契約の予定)
relations.text_en: Selected to run the CCNB Amphitheatre (11-year agreement expected)

source.label: Ryman Hospitality 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We expect to enter into an initial eleven-year management agreement with the City of Simpsonville to manage the venue.
